items.question: What is Search Engine Optimization?
answer: Search Engine Optimization (SEO) is a process of optimizing web pages in order to rank higher on search engine result pages.

items.question: What is The History of SEO?
How does SEO work?
answer: Google SEO work significantly on two task:

list: Crawling– To find the webpages search engine use crawlers, which are also called spiders. It crawls from pages to pages through links to get indexed.
Indexing– After crawling the next process is indexing. Search engines store the content from webpages.
Ranking – Determine the most relevant pages in regards to relevant queries of the user to rank pages accordingly.

Understanding user intent is important as it is what your audience is searching to solve the problem.
Google related searches will give better suggestions on the specific keywords. There are tools to gauge the keyword metrics. Here are tools to use to find right keywords:

list: Ahrefs
SEMrush
Ubersuggest
Google Keyword Planner
Moz

answer: Opt for keywords with high search volume and low competition. Find out the long-term keyword to target. It has less competition and more specific, that easily reaches the audience.

What is E-commerce SEO?
answer: E-commerce SEO is search engine optimization for e-commerce websites Creating and optimizing web pages that help your website rank for the search queries. . So your e-commerce site can be visible whenever any user searches for the products and services you’re selling.

items.question: How do I SEO my E-commerce website?
answer: Follow these steps for E-commerce SEO:

list: Use long-tail keywords: opt for long tail keywords to target what your customers are searching. Optimize keywords for heading, subheadings and product descriptions.
On-page SEO: Optimize your site for title tags, meta descriptions, images and URLs.
High-quality Content: Create high-quality content for your site including product descriptions and blog posts.
Technical SEO: Optimize your site for technical SEO. Remove duplicate content and broken links.
Site Speed: Ensure that your site loading time is fast as possible to reduce bounce rate and improve user experience.
Site architecture: keep your site easy to navigate so with few clicks your customers can get on any page they want.
Mobile-friendly: Make your e-commerce site mobile-friendly so customers can easily buy from their mobile.
Internal Linking: Internal link your product or service pages for better user experience.
URL: Keep your URL short and simple for search engines to crawl.
Social Media: Promote your e-commerce site through social media to drive more traffic to rank high on the SERP.

answer: Optimizing E-commerce sites will improve search engine ranking and drive more traffic and sales for your business.

items.question: Is SEO worth it for e-commerce?
answer: SEO for e-commerce sites will improve ranking and increase visibility. More visibility will drive more traffic which means more sales and revenues. Also, it will help establish your brand which is rewarding for the long-term. In short, SEO is like an investment that every e-commerce site needs. So, SEO is definitely worth e-commerce.

items.question: How is SEO for E-commerce different?
answer: SEO for E-commerce and other websites is different because of different goals and requirements. The main purpose is to rank your product pages high on SERPs. Here’re the key differences:

list: A lot of product and service pages need optimization with relevant keywords, title tags and meta descriptions.
E-commerce websites require different content like product description, blog post, product reviews, etc.
E-commerce sites have category pages, subcategory pages, and product category pages to optimize for specific keywords.
Customer reviews are a priority to improve visibility and ranking that attracts potential customers.

answer: Thus, SEO for e-commerce is different due to different needs.

items.question: Is SEO important for E-commerce?
answer: SEO helps product and category pages to rank high on SERPs. Whenever any user searches for the keyword, your product page will appear on the first result page. This will increase visibility of your webpages and drive more traffic and sales. That’s why SEO is important for e-commerce.

items.question: How Much Does E-commerce SEO Cost?
answer: The cost of e-commerce mainly depends upon the size of business and the competition. Whether you want a inhouse team or outsource services, it can impact your budget.

list: For inhouse-team you have to pay a salary around $5000-$10,000 depending on team’s size and experience. You pay a fixed amount each month.
For hiring an ecommerce SEO agency, you sign a contract with a firm that can be $1000-$10,000 a month.
For a project-based work it can be $1000 to $30,000 depending on a project.
For hiring a freelance consultant hourly rates can be $75 to $300 depending on their expertise.
